title: Nimble Admin SprintKit: Lightweight Runbook Tasks & Autosuggest Remediations
creator: Lina Park
description: Problem: oncall engineers repeatedly run small, ad-hoc remediations (restart service, rotate key, scale pool) that are only partially documented in large runbooks. This increases mean time to repair and produces inconsistent telemetry. Goal: deliver a compact "SprintKit" that lets engineers invoke short, parameterized runbook-tasks from the Console or CLI with contextual autosuggested remediation steps, safety checks, and telemetry hooks. Scope: (1) a task manifest format for short-runbook primitives (idempotent commands + pre/post checks), (2) a lightweight execution surface in the admin Console and ops CLI, (3) an autosuggest engine that maps incident signals+observables to candidate tasks, (4) telemetry and provenance (who ran what, inputs, outputs, result), and (5) gate controls (RBAC + dry-run + canary fallback). Out of scope: long-form runbook authoring UI and full runbook-to-playbook transpilation (future work).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Console shows a 'SprintKit' quick-run UI for related incidents with at least 6 prebuilt task primitives
A2: Tasks are expressed as JSON/YAML manifests and validated by our task linter; schema v1 committed to repo
A3: Autosuggest returns a ranked list of candidate tasks within 1.2s for common incident signals (CPU spike, GPU OOM, KV-cache-miss)
A4: Each task execution produces a provenance event written to AdminAudit (user, inputs, start/finish, exit code) and is queryable in Console
A5: Safety: task runtime runs in sandbox mode by default; any task that changes infra requires two-step confirmation and 'ops-admin' role
A6: Telemetry: success/failure rate, median time-to-complete, and median time-to-invoke surfaced on SprintKit dashboard
comments: 2026-03-02 — Lina Park: Kickoff meeting notes: prioritize idempotency, small scope tasks (<= 8 steps). Agreed to use existing AdminAudit events for provenance.
2026-03-05 — Ravi Desai: Prototype of task manifest schema pushed to drive; initial schema supports inputs, guards, dry_run, rollback_steps. Asking infra for ephemeral credentials pattern.
2026-03-07 — Priya Iyer (SRE reviewer): Feedback — add explicit rate limits to prevent mass-invoke during incidents. Also require a feature flag before enabling autosuggest in prod.
2026-03-09 — Ravi Desai: Integration test plan drafted; mock incident generator will validate autosuggest recall and task execution sandboxing.
2026-03-12 — Lina Park: Design reviewed by PM; plan to open feature-flagged canary in 'dev' org next week. Next step: PR to admin-tools for task linter + schema and console quick-run button.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): implement schema, linter and Console stub; enable for dev org only behind feature flag. Phase 2 (canary): expose to 10% of internal orgs, instrument metrics and user feedback. Phase 3 (prod): enable for all orgs after 2-week canary with success metrics met. Rollback: flip feature flag off; all tasks run in dry-run after rollback until manual audit completed.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: a buggy task primitive could cause cascading failures. Mitigation: sandboxed execution, two-step confirmation for infra-changing tasks, staged canary, and an automatic rate-limiter. Add a 'kill-switch' operator endpoint to abort all SprintKit executions in a region.
implementation_steps: Step 1: Define and land task manifest schema + linter (admin-tools)
Step 2: Build execution sandbox shim and dry-run path (admin-runner service)
Step 3: Console quick-run UI + CLI integration with telemetry hooks
Step 4: Autosuggest prototype using incident signal mapping and simple ranking model
Step 5: Integration tests and runbook acceptance tests
Step 6: Canary rollout and iterate on failure modes
qa_plan: Unit tests for linter and schema; integration tests that simulate incident signals and verify autosuggest candidates; E2E tests for Console + admin-runner in staging; runaway/failure chaos tests to ensure sandboxing and kill-switch work.
owner_notes: Keep task primitives deliberately small (< 8 atomic ops). Encourage reuse by storing canonical tasks in repo under admin-tools/tasks/ready. Coordinate with SRE for credential vending and with Security for KMS access patterns.
